# M059 — File with AP242 ED1 schema string but ED2-only enumeration value

<!-- Auto-generated; edit `STEP_PROBLEM_CATALOG.md` instead. -->

## Sources
- 16-iso-spec AP242 ED1 vs ED2 enumeration changelog

## Description

AP242 ED2 added enumeration values to existing tolerance entities (e.g. `tolerance_zone_form` gained `.WITHIN_A_SPHERE.`, `.NON_UNIFORM.`, and others). A producer upgraded to ED2 but emitting the older ED1 schema string in FILE_SCHEMA writes ED2-only enumeration values that an ED1-conformant parser rejects as invalid enumeration.

## Reproducer recipe

`FILE_SCHEMA(('AP242_MANAGED_MODEL_BASED_3D_ENGINEERING_MIM_LF { 1 0 10303 442 1 1 1 }'))` (ED1) with `TOLERANCE_ZONE_FORM(.WITHIN_A_SPHERE.)` (ED2-only enum).

## Expected kernel behavior

reject unknown enum values in the declared schema; or, in tolerant mode, upgrade the effective schema to the version that recognises the enum and warn.

**Structured outcomes** (extracted from prose; for downstream auto-grading):
- allowed: `reject`
